nodes.label: ia.valor()
nodes.rationale: Recursive pull-based evaluation of a neuron from its incoming connections; sigmoid applied per neuron when Global.lineal is false.

nodes.label: PersonatgeIA.actualizar_fitness()
nodes.rationale: Fitness shaping: +1/s survival plus proximity bonus to the gap (or to the coin when the coin has not been collected).

nodes.label: PersonatgeIA.inputs() (NN input vector)
nodes.rationale: Builds 7 candidate features (bird/obstacle ratio, bird/coin ratio, bird y, obstacle y, obstacle x, vertical speed, coin flag) and keeps only those indexed by Global.inputs.

nodes.label: class ia (neural network genome)
nodes.rationale: Each bird owns one ia instance in Global.population; topology is inputs->(hidden)->1 output, evolved by weight/structure mutations and same-species crossover.

nodes.label: ia.mateixa_especie()
nodes.rationale: Species = identical connection topology; crossover only averages weights between same-species parents.

nodes.label: ia.mutar()
nodes.rationale: Loops up to 1000 random attempts until the mutated network differs from the original (iguals) and has no cycle (infinity), honoring Global.mutacions toggles (0 weight change, 1 structural).

nodes.label: Creador_de_IAs._ready (build generation)
nodes.rationale: Elitist generation step: keep top 10%+1 by fitness, crossover same-species pairs if mutation type 2 enabled, then fill population with mutated copies of the elites (1..num_mutacions mutations each). Gen 0 or manual network mode creates fresh networks.

nodes.label: automatitzacio.gd
nodes.rationale: Empty stub (only pass), presumably reserved for automating runs.

nodes.label: ODS 8: Creixement econòmic sostingut i treball digne

nodes.label: Taula de R² mitjans per inputs × mutacions
nodes.norm_label: taula de r2 mitjans per inputs × mutacions
nodes.rationale: Population excluded because it did not significantly change curve shape; columns without PYO or PYF least logarithmic; PYO,PYF,VYO with MNE,Crs highest (0,893); mean R² of learning graphs 0,73.

nodes.label: Xarxa neuronal complexa (futur)
nodes.rationale: Moving from a linear to a complex network would allow more complex problems (e.g. a coin at random height) and more than one mutation per AI per generation.

nodes.label: Hipòtesi: input 0/1 (relació entre PYO i PYF)
nodes.norm_label: hipotesi: input 0/1 (relacio entre pyo i pyf)
nodes.rationale: Derived from observed connections: what matters is the relation between the two weights, not their magnitude; to be confirmed with a graph using input 0/1.

nodes.label: Inputs 0-1-2-3 (tots): combinació menys eficaç amb info suficient
nodes.norm_label: inputs 0-1-2-3 (tots): combinacio menys eficac amb info suficient
nodes.rationale: Must ignore PXF and VYO; hard with only one mutation per generation — could be fixed by allowing several mutations per network per generation.

nodes.label: Inputs 0-1-2 (PYO-PYF-PXF): més lent que 0-1, millor que 0-1-3
nodes.norm_label: inputs 0-1-2 (pyo-pyf-pxf): mes lent que 0-1, millor que 0-1-3
nodes.rationale: PXF need not be removed: network can either drop it or use it to position the bird as the obstacle nears.

nodes.label: Inputs 0-1-3 (PYO-PYF-VYO): aprenentatge alentit
nodes.rationale: Connections from VYO must be weighted ~0 or removed.

nodes.label: Inputs 0-1 (PYO-PYF): aprenentatge més ràpid
nodes.rationale: These are exactly the inputs needed for the task.

nodes.label: Input 0 (PYO) sol: fitness aleatori 0-4.000
nodes.rationale: Without hole position the bird can only jump below a fixed Y; passes only when holes randomly align.

nodes.label: Input 1 (PYF) sol: no pot passar cap obstacle
nodes.norm_label: input 1 (pyf) sol: no pot passar cap obstacle

nodes.label: APFLY-IA (Autonomous Player Fast Learning Yeld)
nodes.rationale: AI built exclusively for the study, inserted into a custom Flappy Bird 'digital laboratory' in Godot with integrated telemetry to collect behaviour/learning data.

nodes.label: Aprenentatge logarítmic (hipòtesi confirmada)
nodes.rationale: Confirmed over 3.798 games and >450.000 generations: early generations yield large fitness gains, later improvements are subtler; lets one predict a plateau and decide when to stop training or add challenges.

nodes.label: Conclusió: PYO-PYF + MNE + població màxima (100); IA perfecta a partir de la 8a generació
nodes.norm_label: conclusio: pyo-pyf + mne + poblacio maxima (100); ia perfecta a partir de la 8a generacio

nodes.label: Fitness (sistema de puntuació)
nodes.rationale: +1000 per obstacle passed, -100 on hitting ground, +100/50/10/5 per second by proximity to hole centre (PYF), +1 per second alive; capped ~160.000 (150 pipes); learnt when cap reached 3 times in a row.

nodes.label: Excés d'informació alenteix l'aprenentatge
nodes.rationale: Unneeded inputs (PXF, VYO) increase network complexity and must be ignored/removed, slowing or limiting a linear network.

nodes.label: Input combinat PYO/PYF (diferència)
nodes.rationale: Relating PYO and PYF directly via their difference makes learning faster and reduces network complexity (reaches 160.000 by ~gen 20 at population 5).

nodes.label: Importància relativa dels pesos (Exemple d'una IA perfecte)
nodes.norm_label: importancia relativa dels pesos (exemple d'una ia perfecte)
nodes.rationale: What matters is not absolute weight values but the relation between PYO and PYF weights (e.g. 0,509 vs -0,543).

nodes.label: Flappy Bird com a problema lineal
nodes.norm_label: flappy bird com a problema lineal
nodes.rationale: Goal is not to fall below an imaginary horizontal line at the obstacle hole base, solvable by a linear network: jump when y <= hole base.

nodes.label: Prova.gd
nodes.rationale: Scratch/test script checking Array.find membership, unrelated to gameplay.

nodes.label: XarxaNeuronal.gd (NEAT prototype)
nodes.rationale: Early standalone NEAT prototype (fixed 3-2-1 topology, own population loop); mixes Python syntax (def __repr__, __init__) so it does not compile in GDScript and is superseded by classe_IA.gd + Creador_de_IAs.gd.

nodes.label: classe_IA.gd (autoload ClasseIa)
nodes.rationale: Autoload exposing the inner class ia (the per-bird neural network genome) so any script can do ClasseIa.ia.new().

nodes.label: Constants experimentals (20-30 partides, 125 generacions, max 150 tubs)
nodes.norm_label: constants experimentals (20-30 partides, 125 generacions, max 150 tubs)

nodes.label: Estructura predeterminada gen. 0 (inputs connectats directament a output)
nodes.norm_label: estructura predeterminada gen. 0 (inputs connectats directament a output)

nodes.label: Funció d'activació sigmoide (salt si >0,7)
nodes.rationale: Bounds output neuron to 0..1; the bird jumps when value exceeds 0.7.

nodes.label: Artificial Neural Network with Layer Coloring (Glosser.ca, 2013)
nodes.norm_label: artificial neural network with layer coloring (glosser.ca, 2013)

nodes.label: Mutació 0 (no estructural): fitness més alt i estable
nodes.norm_label: mutacio 0 (no estructural): fitness mes alt i estable

nodes.label: Mutació 1 (estructural): valors dispersos, fitness més baix
nodes.norm_label: mutacio 1 (estructural): valors dispersos, fitness mes baix

nodes.label: Mutació 2 (crossover): sense canvis notables; dispersió en 20% dels casos amb mutació 0
nodes.norm_label: mutacio 2 (crossover): sense canvis notables; dispersio en 20% dels casos amb mutacio 0

nodes.label: Més població per generació → aprenentatge més ràpid
nodes.norm_label: mes poblacio per generacio → aprenentatge mes rapid
nodes.rationale: More neural networks present per generation raises the probability of efficient results that later generations inherit.

nodes.label: Crossover (Crs)
nodes.rationale: Two parents with identical structure produce a child with same structure and arithmetic-mean weights.

nodes.label: Mutació estructural (ME)
nodes.rationale: Modifies the graph: adds/removes a neuron (with its connections) or adds/removes a connection.

nodes.label: Mutació no estructural (MNE)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the weight of one connection with a random value.

nodes.label: NEAT (Neuro Evolution of Augmenting Topologies)
nodes.rationale: Genetic algorithm inspired by Darwinian theory used to train the network by evolving both weights and topology.

nodes.label: Processament i recollida de dades distribuïda (JSON)
nodes.norm_label: processament i recollida de dades distribuida (json)
nodes.rationale: Low-cost alternative to more powerful GPUs: volunteers run parametrised game copies and send JSON results to a central system; trade-off: more development effort vs scalability.

nodes.label: Selecció del 10% + 1 millors agents
nodes.rationale: Best 10%+1 agents by fitness are carried to next generation; the rest are created by mutating or crossing them.

nodes.label: Input action R (force end of round)
nodes.norm_label: input action r (force end of round)

nodes.label: Input action Xarxa_aleatoria (key A: randomize networks)
nodes.norm_label: input action xarxa_aleatoria (key a: randomize networks)

nodes.label: escena_ia.desa_arxiu()
nodes.rationale: Finds the first free filename by recursion on Global.num so earlier results are never overwritten.

nodes.label: escena_ia._process (round/generation control)
nodes.rationale: Ends a round when all AIs die or score reaches puntuacio_max; a run (partida) ends after num_gen_max generations or 3 consecutive max-score generations; after num_partidas runs it writes result files and returns to the menu, otherwise reloads escena_ia.tscn to spawn the next generation.

nodes.label: DadesExcel/PY_<nom>_<n>.txt (fitness series for Python)
nodes.rationale: Comma-separated max fitness per generation, one line per run, meant to be processed by external Python code ("UN FITXER QUE EL CODI DE PYTHON PROCESSI").

nodes.label: project.godot
nodes.rationale: Godot 4.2 project config: main scene inteficie.tscn, autoloads Global and ClasseIa, 320x480 viewport, input map.

nodes.label: Global.gd (autoload Global)
nodes.rationale: Autoload singleton used as the shared blackboard for all scenes: game state flags, the AI population, configuration chosen in menus, and accumulated result strings written to disk.
